- 202a1fb (a change to `pipeline`, so its dependents' flow ran, not a fully warm run): runner wrote 1.5 GB (4e55c57: 6.6 GB), kernel I/O pressure peak 4%, CPU I/O wait peak 0%. Busy 1.94 cores = containers 1.39 + hypervisor 0.11 + not in a container 0.44; the kernel's own share was 25% of 2 cores (0.5), which is that remainder.

- "Peak VM CPU under 60%" cannot hold while a run is CPU-bound and fast: both numbers above are 97% average, and the run is 4.7 min of flow tests. What a faster run changes is how long the CPU is busy. The budget gates the I/O wait and the duration, not the CPU peak.

- Ledger of run b4b490e (written by the job itself): crate-deploy:cargo-flow 248.7 s, crate-wf:cargo-flow 94.1 s, crate-pipeline:cargo-flow 38.7 s, crate-wf:cargo-e2e-smoke 19.8 s, wf cargo-unit 14.4 s, pipeline clippy 12.0 s, wf clippy 10.7 s, pipeline cargo-unit 7.6 s, deploy clippy 7.1 s, typecheck 1.4 s (all ran; 8 e2e tasks hit). The deploy flow tests are two scenario tests that run `wf ship --changed` about 50 times each on a copy of the repo (4-core sandbox: 82 s, 69 s, 25 s).

- One `wf ship --changed` costs 1.6-1.9 s: 364 `git show` spawns (about 0.5 s) and one `pnpm --filter ...[sha] list` (0.68 s). `pnpm --version` alone is 0.665 s because pnpm checks the pinned version before running (`manage-package-manager-versions`); 0.22 s with it off. Set for the whole CI workflow and for wf's own pnpm call; the same call is 0.30 s. Deploy scenario tests 82 s -> 62 s, 69 s -> 65 s. Tried and reverted: one `git cat-file --batch` reader (the flow tests' git stub only understands `show`), and a per-process `show` cache (160 spawns instead of 364, no measurable time).

- Run 56dd212 (20m 34s): `crate-pipeline:cargo-contract` ran 694 s because `legs.rs` was edited and the contract selection was a deny-list of files that cannot move it (`ci_*.rs`, help, report tests). Only `nx.rs`, `e2e_tests.rs`, `test_plan.rs`, `verify.rs`, the router and binaries, the contract's own tests and support, and manifests can move it, so it is now an allow-list (`outside_the_contract` in `test_plan.rs`); the weekly cold run plans every test and is the backstop.
